import importlib.util, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
mvars = 64
occ = []; scopes = []
for e in range(mvars):
    others = [min(mvars-1, e+1+k) for k in range(4)]
    others = sorted({x for x in others if x != e})[:4]
    scope = tuple(sorted([e] + others))
    scopes.append(scope)
    groups = {}
    for a in [None] + [(v, d) for v in others for d in (1, 2)]:
        for b in [None] + [(v, d) for v in others for d in (1, 2)]:
            if a and b and a[0] == b[0]: continue
            if b and b[0] == e: continue
            if a and a[0] == e: continue
            lk = (0, -1) if a is None else (a[1], a[0])
            rk = (3, -1) if b is None else (b[1], b[0])
            groups[(lk, rk)] = 1000
    occ.append(groups)
print('groups per var', len(occ[0]))
order = list(range(mvars))
m._check_width(scopes, order, mvars)
print('width ok')
t=time.time(); factors = m._tables(occ, scopes, mvars); print('tables %.2fs' % (time.time()-t))
t=time.time(); z, marg = m._eliminate(factors, order); print('eliminate %.2fs Z digits %d' % (time.time()-t, len(str(z))))
